baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated accusatives at focus words 1 and 2 name olive and date-palm collectives.
baseline_models.mechanism: The olive branch permits tree, fruit, and collective reference, while the palm branch names the date-palm tree in singular or collective use. Their coordination foregrounds two standing, repeat-bearing arboreal sources rather than merely two detached servings.

activation_trace.role: The olive tree-or-fruit image supplies the first living arboreal source and preserves collective reference.
The date-palm tree image supplies the second arboreal source and makes the pair a stand of productive trees.

changed_reading.before: The ayah adds two more edible items to a list.
changed_reading.after: The ayah inserts a paired stand of long-lived fruit-bearing sources, shifting attention from consumed items to the organisms that repeatedly produce them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus roots carry non-botanical branches of oil extraction, pressing, sifting, and selection.
baseline_models.mechanism: Olive opens toward released oil and the work of the presser; palm opens toward filtering and choosing the best. Read together, the pair can compress a material grammar in which yield is released, separated, and selected, while the surface nouns still denote the plants.

activation_trace.role: The oil-and-extract image turns the olive from an item into matter whose useful yield is released.
The seller-and-presser image adds skilled extraction and circulation to the olive's functional range.
The sieve image contributes separation of usable material from residue.
The choosing-the-best image gives separation a selective rather than merely mechanical end.

changed_reading.before: Olive and palm are static species labels.
changed_reading.after: Alongside their literal species sense, they carry a latent press-and-sieve economy: provision becomes available through transformation, sorting, and choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier increase and purification share one root field, purified pages then preserve the cleansing register, and later vegetation visibly emerges from earth. The olive and palm can therefore materialize cultivated purification as growth that becomes externally fruitful.

activation_trace.role: The olive tree-or-fruit image gives the growth-and-purification analogy a mature visible result.
The date-palm image adds a second mature organism whose increase depends on cultivation.
The increase-and-growth image supplies the developmental side of purification.
The purity-and-soundness image keeps that developmental process ethically charged.
The removal-of-stain image extends purification from the seeker to the protected medium of reminder.
The plant-emerging-from-earth image converts abstract increase into the immediate process that yields the focus trees.

structural_cues: 80:3-14 places purification and preservation vocabulary before 80:24-29's material cultivation sequence.
At 80:27-29 the list moves from generic emergence to named mature trees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, purity, and plant-emergence images; I infer that their ordered recurrence lets the trees embody cultivated purification. A live alternative keeps spiritual purification and botany as parallel but unconnected registers.

changed_reading.before: Olive and palm are outputs of rainfall and soil.
changed_reading.after: They also present purification as enabled growth: what receives the right conditions becomes sound, increases, and bears visible benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim of self-sufficiency is answered by an extended production chain: water must be delivered, living sources must bear, and their goods become usable provision. The late return of sufficiency as a burden that isolates each person sharpens the contrast between sustaining interdependence and terminal self-absorption.

activation_trace.role: Oil as condiment, provision, or gift makes the olive a circulated support rather than an autonomous possession.
The date-palm tree supplies a living producer whose yield depends on an ecology outside the eater.
The self-sufficiency image supplies the posture that the food-production chain destabilizes.
The delivery of water by irrigation or pouring supplies the enabling input before either focus tree can yield.
The useful thing that meets needs assigns the botanical list an explicitly sustaining function.
The sufficing burden at the later occurrence reverses sufficiency from social prestige into isolating preoccupation.

structural_cues: The self-sufficient figure of 80:5 precedes the imperative to inspect one's food at 80:24.
The first-person plural production sequence at 80:25-29 terminates in benefit for humans and livestock at 80:32.
The same sufficiency root returns at 80:37 after family bonds are abandoned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two sufficiency images and the intervening production-and-use sequence; I infer that produced food exposes dependence and revises the earlier social valuation of autonomy. Alternatively, the two sufficiency occurrences may frame separate scenes without making the crops an argument against autonomy.

changed_reading.before: The pair is simply part of a generous food catalogue.
changed_reading.after: The pair becomes evidence against imagined self-sufficiency: even compact, durable provision arrives through water, soil, living producers, labor, and circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hidden or lowered state is followed by revival, opening, and emergence. The olive and palm are mature outcomes of that sequence, so the agricultural scene can function as a material analogue for the preceding human arc from death and burial to renewed rising.

activation_trace.role: The mature olive tree-or-fruit image supplies one visible endpoint of hidden-to-emergent development.
The mature palm supplies a second endpoint and extends the emergence pattern into vertical growth.
The hidden-and-lowered image supplies the occluded phase shared by burial and seed-like placement.
The rain-revived dry herbage image directly bridges renewed life and vegetation.
The splitting-open image supplies the release event between concealment and emergence.
The plant-coming-out-of-earth image makes the release event visibly productive.

structural_cues: 80:19-22 narrates human origination, death, burial, and renewed rising.
80:25-29 repeats an input, opening, emergence, and mature-life sequence in the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered cycles and a branch explicitly describing rain-revived herbage; I infer a cross-cycle analogy in which the focus trees are mature evidence of emergence. The live alternative is that the human and agricultural sequences remain adjacent proofs without mapping phase onto phase.

changed_reading.before: The olive and palm are mature crops in a water-to-food sequence.
changed_reading.after: They are also the visible far end of a concealed-life cycle, making mature trees an experiential model for life released after burial-like hiddenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cutting and separating immediately precede the focus, while useful provision follows it. These context images activate the focus roots' pressing, sifting, and selecting branches, turning the local catalogue into a chain from harvest through transformation to usable goods.

activation_trace.role: The oil presser and seller image supplies extraction work and onward circulation.
The sieve image supplies post-harvest separation into usable and residual material.
The choosing-the-best image turns separation into deliberate selection of yield.
The cutting-and-separating image supplies the harvest operation just before the focus pair.
The rod-and-branch image keeps that cutting operation attached to plant material.
The needs-serving useful object image supplies the chain's functional endpoint.

structural_cues: The cut herbage of 80:28, focus trees of 80:29, fruit and pasture of 80:31, and utility statement of 80:32 occur contiguously.
The repeated coordinated accusatives make both raw species and operations on their yields available without replacing the literal list.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cutting before the focus, processing branches inside the focus roots, and utility after it; I infer a harvest-to-use arrow. A live alternative reads every item only taxonomically and leaves pressing and sifting dormant.

changed_reading.before: The pair names raw produce in an inventory.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a processing hinge: plant matter is cut, pressed, filtered, selected, and converted into provision that can circulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following enclosed-garden and thick-interwoven growth images spatialize the focus pair. Olive and palm become the vertical productive structure of a bounded, dense orchard rather than two isolated labels.

activation_trace.role: The olive-tree collective supplies one layer of the orchard's standing productive structure.
The palm-tree collective supplies height and a second layer of standing productive structure.
The enclosed-garden image gives the tree pair a bounded cultivated space.
The thick, intense, interwoven image gives that space density and mass.

structural_cues: 80:29 and 80:30 are adjacent members of one coordinated accusative catalogue.
Tree collectives are followed immediately by a plural garden term and a density adjective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tree collectives followed by enclosed dense gardens; I infer that the latter spatially frames the former. Alternatively, the gardens may be a separate item whose vegetation need not be identified with the olive and palm.

changed_reading.before: Olive and palm stand as two independent crop names.
changed_reading.after: They form the interior architecture of cultivated abundance: differentiated tree layers held within dense enclosed gardens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same material acts that cultivation needs can reverse ethically. Seed-covering protects hidden life and ordered splitting releases growth; concealment of truth and violation of a covering turn those acts destructive. The mature olive and palm are evidence of productive covering and rupture placed between the two negative human labels.

activation_trace.role: The mature olive image is one positive yield of protected hidden growth and ordered emergence.
The mature palm image is the second positive yield and makes the reversal materially visible.
The covering-of-seed image supplies a beneficial concealment that enables later growth.
The opening-by-splitting image supplies the controlled rupture through which hidden life is released.
The emergence of vegetation verifies that covering and splitting have operated productively.
The hiding-of-truth image reverses protective covering into culpable concealment.
The deviation-and-breach image reverses earth-opening into a violation of rightful bounds.

structural_cues: The first human condemnation at 80:17 and the final classification at 80:42 bracket the food-and-growth sequence.
Earth is explicitly split at 80:26 before the focus trees appear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive and destructive branch images for covering and rupture; I assign the directional contrast and read the focus trees as the positive middle term. A live alternative treats these as unrelated root branches whose coexistence should not structure the ayah.

changed_reading.before: The trees are neutral products of opened earth.
changed_reading.after: They display a disciplined material paradox: life needs shelter and rupture in their proper order, exposing how concealment and breach become ruinous when their object and direction change.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the explicit food catalogue, non-botanical surface words carry branch images of palms, small palms, grapevine, and an ear of grain. The focus palm therefore reads as disclosure of a submerged agricultural thread, while olive adds a new oil-bearing member to that latent orchard.

activation_trace.role: The literal olive tree-or-fruit image adds a new explicit species when the submerged plant register surfaces.
The literal date-palm image discloses as surface reference what earlier context branches held latently.
The branch image explicitly naming a class of palms plants the first latent palm cue under a social-attention verb.
The small-palms image supplies an immature palm stage before the mature focus noun.
The grape-and-vine image anticipates the literal grape immediately before the focus pair.
The extended ear-of-grain image anticipates the literal grain that opens the food catalogue.

structural_cues: The triggering source words at 80:6, 80:12, 80:13, and 80:20 are not botanical in their local surface constructions.
Their dormant plant images surface in order as grain, grape, olive, and palm at 80:27-29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact pre-focus plant branches and later literal plant nouns; I infer a delayed disclosure pattern rather than treating 80:24 as a wholly abrupt thematic start. The live alternative is accidental overlap among broad lexical inventories.

changed_reading.before: Olive and palm arrive only when the discourse turns explicitly to food.
changed_reading.after: Palm arrives as the overt culmination of plant images already latent under earlier words, and olive expands that disclosed orchard toward oil and extraction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because a tree in the food list is linked to later facial joy, but it remains anchored by the literal palm at 80:29 and the exact branch image of palm-spathe and date splitting under laughter at 80:39. Downstream prose should present it as a material-lexical echo, not claim that laughter semantically means palm bloom in this construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 literally names the palm whose opening inflorescence reappears as a branch image under later laughter.

activation_trace.role: The literal date-palm tree supplies the organism whose later opening can image an opened joyful face.
The splitting of palm spathe and dates gives laughter a precise botanical opening image.
The first-signs image extends opening into emergence and arrival of good news.

changed_reading.before: The palm is exhausted by its role as food-producing tree.
changed_reading.after: The palm also seeds a later morphology of joy: its concealed growth opens outward just as delighted faces visibly open.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is branch-distant because the surface palm noun does not denote a sieve, yet the focus root explicitly carries sifting and best-selection while the opening scene distributes attention between a blind seeker and a self-sufficient figure. It remains anchored as a critique activated through the palm root; downstream prose should call it an exploratory counter-selection image, not a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 carries sifting and best-selection branches, while focus word 1 carries provision that can be shared.

activation_trace.role: Oil as provision or gift supplies a shareable good against which social exclusion can be measured.
The sieve image supplies the act of separating recipients or material.
The best-selection image makes the criterion of separation contestable.
The loss-of-sight image marks the seeker whose visible condition becomes part of the mistaken attention filter.
The self-sufficiency image marks the figure incorrectly favored by that filter.
Purposeful movement toward a sought goal supplies positive evidence that the ignored seeker should have survived the filter.
Distraction by one thing from another supplies the mechanism by which attention is misallocated.

changed_reading.before: The palm is one indiscriminate gift among many.
changed_reading.after: Its dormant sieve image asks what counts as the best yield or recipient, turning abundant provision into a quiet rebuke of criteria that filter out the earnest seeker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading crosses from olive-derived anointing to the later surfaces of faces, so it is not a direct syntactic reading of 80:29. It remains validly anchored in the olive root's oiling branch and in packet branches that contrast luster with dust and overpowering cover. Downstream prose should frame it as a surface-material echo and preserve the brighter and darker outcomes as alternatives, not identify olive oil with either face state.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 names the olive whose oil can coat or anoint a surface.

activation_trace.role: The oiling-and-anointing image makes the olive a source of beneficial surface transformation.
Water-like luster in face, speech, or fruit bridges irrigated produce and visibly bright surfaces.
The face-and-front surface image supplies the later human surface on which outcomes appear.
The dust-colored overlay supplies the harmful counter-coating on the later faces.
The overwhelming cover image turns the dark surface condition into an imposed, dominating layer.

changed_reading.before: The olive contributes only edible produce.
changed_reading.after: Through its anointing branch, it also opens a surface register that later divides into water-like radiance and faces overlaid by dust and constriction.

strongest_changes: The static pair became two standing production nodes inside a water, earth-opening, emergence, and mature-growth cycle.
The pair became evidence against self-sufficiency because its provision depends on ecology, labor, transformation, and circulation.
The focus roots' pressing, sifting, and selection branches converted the local catalogue into a harvest-to-use chain without displacing the literal trees.
Earlier dormant palm, vine, and grain branches made 80:29 a disclosure of latent agriculture rather than a wholly abrupt botanical arrival.
Productive covering and splitting around the trees remained live beside their destructive reversals in concealment and breach.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair supports several coexisting scales at once: literal perennial trees, processed provision, selective labor, orchard architecture, a hidden-to-emergent life cycle, and surprising lexical echoes into social attention and later faces. Its palm root is especially activating because tree, sieve, best-selection, and pre-focus palm images remain simultaneously available.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether pressing and sifting should remain functional resonance or bear semantic weight in these surface plant nouns.
Whether the human burial-and-rising sequence and the agricultural emergence sequence invite phase-by-phase analogy or only adjacent comparison.
Whether the seed-covering and moral-concealment reversal is compositional or an artifact of preserving distant root branches.
Whether palm bloom, face opening, and olive-derived surface treatment are intended echoes or only valuable exploratory activations.
